svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Posts: two SHS 30 x 30 x 3, 300 mm apart, from the chord bottom up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to 110 mm above the carriage rail; tied by two cross members.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top wheels: 60 mm double-flanged, 40 mm tread, on 20 mm stub axles

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: welded into the posts; they ride on top of the carriage rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guide rollers: 40 mm ball-bearing rollers on vertical pins, on arms

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the post feet; they bear on the outer face of the bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: chord and stop the hopper's weight swinging the frame in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crank post: SHS 30 x 30 x 3 up to 30 mm over the crank shaft; 21 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bearing hole at 1,260 mm above the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hopper brackets: 6 mm plates from each post to the hopper wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Housing shelf: 6 x 120 mm plate under the rotor housing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamp: M12 screw with a pad that clamps the frame to the rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: rolls the full rail with 2 to 5 mm play at the rollers.
